articles.title: NASA's Upgraded Space Lab Creates Fifth State of Matter, Pushing Quantum Boundaries
articles.summary: A mini-fridge-sized lab on the ISS has been upgraded to chill atoms to near absolute zero, forming a Bose-Einstein condensate—a fifth state of matter. In microgravity, these matter waves expand and last longer, enabling unprecedented quantum experiments that could revolutionize sensors and navigation.

articles.title: SETI Scans Interstellar Visitor 3I/ATLAS for Alien Tech—and Finds a Blueprint for Future Searches
articles.summary: When the third known interstellar object, 3I/ATLAS, entered our solar system, scientists rapidly scanned it for technosignatures. No alien signals were found, but the exercise demonstrated how quickly we can now check such visitors and set new limits on potential extraterrestrial transmitters.

articles.title: Sodium-Ion Battery Matches Tesla's Quality in Surprise Test, Paving Way for Cheaper EVs
articles.summary: Independent testing of a Chinese sodium-ion battery revealed manufacturing uniformity and power performance rivaling Tesla's lithium-ion cells. While energy density and cold-weather charging remain hurdles, the results suggest sodium could soon slash costs for stationary storage and shorter-range vehicles.
